after.hourglass/gaps.py:
# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError


def _free_spans(spans: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[Span]:
    merged = merge_spans(spans)
    starts = [opening.start] + [item.end for item in merged]
    ends = [item.start for item in merged] + [opening.end]
    return [Span(begin, stop) for begin, stop in zip(starts, ends) if begin < stop]


# ---
def uncovered_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)'."""
    spans = list(worked)
    if any(item.start < opening.start or item.end > opening.end for item in spans):
        raise ProjectError("worked span falls outside opening hours")
    return [f"gap {format_span(free)} ({free.minutes} min)" for free in _free_spans(spans, opening)]
